scope_note: A bounded, rights-cleared visual archive of defining scenes from recent youth-led protest movements. Selection reflects documentary value and sourceability, not a claim that every photograph is universally iconic.

records.title: Bangla Blockade

image.caption: Student demonstrators during the quota-reform movement in Bangladesh on 11 July 2024.

records.what_this_shows: A student-led quota-reform action during the Bangla Blockade phase, when demonstrators used coordinated road and rail blockades to press demands over public-service recruitment quotas.
records.why_it_matters: The frame records a named movement tactic and a dense field of participant-made signs, rather than reducing the case to a generic crowd photograph.

context_sources.title: What is happening at the quota-reform protests in Bangladesh?
Quota reform protesters start road blockade in Dhaka amid warning by police
